personas.name: E-Commerce Merchant
personas.description: Online store owner or operations manager evaluating shipping carriers for their Canadian or cross-border fulfillment. Comparing cost, speed, reliability, and tracking capabilities across last-mile providers.

personas.name: Online Shopper / Package Recipient
personas.description: Canadian consumer who has received or is expecting a UniUni delivery. Searching for tracking info, delivery status, or reviews of the delivery experience.

personas.name: Logistics / 3PL Decision Maker
personas.description: Supply chain or fulfillment professional evaluating last-mile partners for a 3PL, marketplace, or enterprise retailer. Focused on network coverage, SLAs, integration, and cost per delivery.

personas.name: Gig Driver / Delivery Partner
personas.description: Person exploring delivery driving opportunities, comparing UniUni driver pay and flexibility against Uber Eats, DoorDash, Amazon Flex, and other gig platforms.

personas.name: Cross-Border Shipper
personas.description: US-based e-commerce brand or fulfillment center looking for reliable, affordable US-to-Canada shipping without customs headaches or multiple carrier handoffs.
